task_contract.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
task_contract.public_requirements: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year

results.final_sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID=c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND c.Currency='EUR'
    AND (substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' OR substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT segment,
       ((c2013-c2012)*100.0/c2013) AS pct_increase,
       CASE WHEN (c2013-c2012)*100.0/c2013 = MAX((c2013-c2012)*100.0/c2013) OVER () THEN 'biggest'
            WHEN (c2013-c2012)*100.0/c2013 = MIN((c2013-c2012)*100.0/c2013) OVER () THEN 'lowest'
       END AS label
FROM agg
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

SELECT Survived, COUNT(*) n, AVG(Fare) mean_fare,
       SQRT(SUM((Fare - (SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d2 WHERE d2.Sex='male' AND d2.Survived=d.Survived))*(Fare - (SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d3 WHERE d3.Sex='male' AND d3.Survived=d.Survived)))/(COUNT(*)-1)) std_fare
FROM data d WHERE Sex='male' GROUP BY Survived

WITH g AS (
  SELECT Survived, COUNT(*) n, AVG(Fare) m,
         SUM((Fare-(SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d2 WHERE d2.Sex='male' AND d2.Survived=d.Survived))*(Fare-(SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d3 WHERE d3.Sex='male' AND d3.Survived=d.Survived)))/(COUNT(*)-1) v
  FROM data d WHERE Sex='male' GROUP BY Survived
), a AS (SELECT * FROM g WHERE Survived=1), b AS (SELECT * FROM g WHERE Survived=0)
SELECT 2.0*(1.0 - (1.0/2.0 + 0.5*0) ) AS dummy,
  -- use Welch with normal approximation for p
  a.m AS m1, b.m AS m0, a.n AS n1, b.n AS n0,
  (a.m-b.m)/SQRT(a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n) AS t_stat,
  (a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n)*(a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n)/((a.v/a.n)*(a.v/a.n)/(a.n-1) + (b.v/b.n)*(b.v/b.n)/(b.n-1)) AS df
FROM a,b

WITH g AS (
  SELECT Survived, COUNT(*) n, AVG(Fare) m,
         SUM((Fare-(SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d2 WHERE d2.Sex='male' AND d2.Survived=d.Survived))*(Fare-(SELECT AVG(Fare) FROM data d3 WHERE d3.Sex='male' AND d3.Survived=d.Survived)))/(COUNT(*)-1) v
  FROM data d WHERE Sex='male' GROUP BY Survived
), a AS (SELECT * FROM g WHERE Survived=1), b AS (SELECT * FROM g WHERE Survived=0),
p AS (SELECT (a.m-b.m)/SQRT(a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n) AS t,
  (a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n)*(a.v/a.n + b.v/b.n)/((a.v/a.n)*(a.v/a.n)/(a.n-1) + (b.v/b.n)*(b.v/b.n)/(b.n-1)) AS df
  FROM a,b)
-- two-sided p via incomplete beta: p = I_{df/(df+t^2)}(df/2, 1/2)
SELECT t, df,
  (SELECT 1.0 FROM p) AS dummy,
  CASE WHEN t < 0 THEN 'neg' ELSE 'pos' END AS sign
FROM p

WITH RECURSIVE
p(t,df) AS (SELECT 2.695537826819596, 118.56433289546052),
-- compute regularized incomplete beta I_x(a,b) via continued fraction for x = df/(df+t^2)
terms AS (
  SELECT 1 AS k, 1.0 AS cf_prev
),
-- We'll do a fixed 200-iteration Lentz-free sum for the series I_x(a,b) using small x
val AS (
  SELECT x.a AS aa, x.b AS bb, x.x0 AS xx FROM (
    SELECT df/2.0 AS a, 0.5 AS b, (df/(df+t*t)) AS x0 FROM p
  ) x
),
-- series: I_x = x^a (1-x)^b / (a B(a,b)) * sum_{n=0} (B(a+1,n+1)/... ) use simple recursion
sums AS (
  SELECT aa,bb,xx, 0 AS n, 1.0 AS term, 1.0 AS acc FROM val
  UNION ALL
  SELECT aa,bb,xx, n+1, term*((aa+n)*(1.0))/(n+1.0)*(xx), acc + term*((aa+n)*(1.0))/(n+1.0)*(xx)
  FROM sums WHERE n < 300
)
SELECT 1.0 AS ok,
  (SELECT MAX(acc) FROM sums) AS series_sum,
  aa,bb,xx FROM sums ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
